SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS distinct_ids, MIN(o.order_ts_utc) AS min_ts, MAX(o.order_ts_utc) AS max_ts
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.calendar_date, d.day_name, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_week, d.is_trading_day, d.is_public_holiday, d.holiday_name
FROM dim_date d WHERE d.calendar_date = DATE '2025-12-01'

calls.statement:
SELECT o.status, o.web_order_id, o.line_count, o.order_total_gross,
       COUNT(f.sales_line_id) AS lines,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.category = 'ZZ Test') AS test_lines,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.store_id = 999) AS store999_lines
FROM fact_web_order o
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id = o.web_order_id
LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.category = 'ZZ Test') > 0 OR COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.store_id = 999) > 0 OR (o.status <> 'cancelled' AND COUNT(f.sales_line_id) = 0)

SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS helsinki_date, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'cancelled') AS orders, COUNT(*) AS all_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS ids
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE o.order_ts_utc BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2025-11-27' AND TIMESTAMP '2025-12-04'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS web_orders
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
